avis.texte: This moisturizer helps clear any acne that develops. It is the best moisturizer I have ever used!

avis.titre: Perfect hydration for all skin types
avis.texte: Easy to apply, not oily , and moisturizes perfectly. Very pleased with consistent results!

This formula is hydrating without being too hydrating. I've been using for years and switch over to this system when I was in my mid 30s. I think this formula would be better if they added niacinamide to help refine pores but also add a glow that dull aging skin could use.

I will be sixty years old in a few short days. I have been using Proactive for over fifteen years now. Growing up as a teenager with acne, It was embarrassing and devastating! I only wish Proactive was available back then. Thanks Proactive.
It's been almost 6 months since I started using proactiv and I'm loving the results.

avis.titre: Been using for years.. holy grail!
avis.texte: I love this moisturizer. It works great on my oily acne prone skin. Its been ny holy grail for years!
I love all the products and they have definitely helped my skin. The routine is easy to follow and the outcome is amazing.
I really like this product. It hydrates my combination skin. I highly recommend.
Great product fixed my skin I used to have so many pimples but now I have clear skin

The reason for the three stars is because though this moisturizer is decent it fails to keep my mature skin moisturized all day. I found myself reapplying this moisturizer two, sometimes three times a day depending on what season we are in, due to dry patches that become so vivid on my face. There use to be a moisturizer that Proactiv carried that kept my mature skin moisturized all day. I don't know why it was discontinued it and unfortunately, I cannot remember the name. I love the night-time moisturizer for mature skin, it is amazing however, it is not meant for all day moisturizing. Please bring back the moisturizer that was discontinued or introduce a new one that is solely meant for skin that needs an abundance of moisture.
It cleared up my dry flaky skin almost instantly. My skin is so soft now.
Love this product! It does an excellent job maintaining a healthy look and balance!
The lotion is not hydrating enough for my skin. I still feel dry after use.
I have had great results using Proactive products ! Would highly recommend.
Love this product - especially in the winter. Does a great job of moisturizing without making face oily.

I've bought many different moisturizers that either makes your skin break out, stay greasy &/or not absorb, while hydrating your skin in the meantime- which is what this hydrator does. I don't see myself using any other. I use the 3 step Proactive + system which works perfectly for me as a 55 year old woman

I love this product! It hydrates my skin without being oily or sticky feeling. I have sensitive skin and feel moisturizers often break me out. This one doesn't and feels so good on. A little goes a long way.
It has done wonders for my grandson's acne It has given him a new sense of confidence so thank you very much

avis.titre: I have seen it work but not for me
avis.texte: I have been using this product for a couple of months and seen people get a good result, but I have not seen a difference.
Great moisturizer, it's not too oily and it gives your skin that perfect glow
I only use the steps daily because I get dry skin. Step 3 keeps my skin hydrated all day

Honestly, At 43 I was at my wits end. I was feeling like my body was betraying. I could NOT seem to get my acne under control. I was convinced my hormones were out of wack and I was perimenopausal. I decided to give Proactiv a try and within a couple of months my skin was COMPLETELY clear. I've been using it ever since (over a year now) and my skin still feels amazing and is clear. Thank you!

I have been using proactive products for over 20 years. Until the last two years customer service has been good and they have addressed issues with my auto service program. Even though I explained that I now have enough product to last me for the next two years because they keep sending me the same product rather than what my order should be and correcting the set up problem on their end, I had to argue with the customer service representative and still there was no satisfactory resolution.
I went to the doctor, they prescribed medication it did nothing.. I bought proactive no more issues...

I love this product. Ulta stopped carrying it in the store and now I can only purchase it online. huge inconvenience. The moisturizer is great for older skin, acne prone skin,and keeping your skin hydrated. I use it twice a day. I am very unhappy about the huge price increase. Big bummer, but I need the product.
My daughter was able to see the difference by using Proactive. We are glad we switched and try this on. Love it!

First time I used this, my skin got an extremely dry patch the next day. I cut back on the amount I was using and have not had a problem since. It seems gentler than the original Proactiv formula I've been using.

avis.titre: Did not work with couple of months of disciplined use
avis.texte: Did not make difference even after a disciplined use of the entire kit twice a day for couple of months. Acne stayed almost the same.

avis.titre: Love all of the Proactive+ Products
avis.texte: My skin has never looked so good. It's so clear, even, and glowing. I have normal skin, don't really have acne or pimple problems, but have the occasional hormonal stubborn pimples. Along with the + line I use the toner, the post mark and scar relief and the charcoal cleansing brush. If I do get a tough pimple I use the MD cream.
Some days I feel like it's working. Some days I don't. My skin has been so dry after using.
I love this lotion! It leaves my skin feeling and looking smooth, shiny and hydrated.:ok_hand:My only complaint is that there isn't enough of it…
I love this product. I need something for anti-aging and acne and this addresses both.
Great product. I use the whole set and it makes my skin look amazing. My skin truly glows again.
I purchased this moisturizer to help with the extra dryness in my skin during the fall & winter months. It is wonderful!

I cannot use any other lotion on my skin but this brand. I've tried any almost everything else leaves my skin broken out or red and puffy. I have tried so many other brands but this one consistently works. I've been using Proactiv since it first came out. Long time customer and I'm so thankful for this product!

I'm in my 60's and have been trying to find something to hydrate my face without it breaking out. I have large pores so even the products I've used that are for acne prone sensitive skin still cause zits. I have had several small ones with this product, but am trying to give it a chance for a bit longer.
Love this moisturizer! First face moisturizer that hasn't caused me to break out (even supposedly non-comedogenic ones cause me to break out), so I'm thrilled
I have used alit of hydrators but this one works very well. And you dint need very much ti do the job
I'm so very pleased with this lotion. My face has combination of dry and extra dry. I feel like my face is finally in hydration heaven. Thank you.
I love how it moisturizes my skin. I've been using proactive for at least 10 years now.

I have used Proactiv since I was a teen. Always worked for me. when Proactiv+ came out I tried it and loved it on my older more sensitive skin. I was so happy when I found out Ulta was carrying it because I didn't want the hassle of the subscription. My bad review is not of the product, but what I was given from Ulta. The expiration date is 11/23 and I received it on 9/23. I understand if used as directed it should be used in a month, but I use the product as a maintenance and it works for me well that way.
Love it but to much oil. I have oily skin. What would recomrmene
So far so good. Adult acne and blemishes gone. It was harsh at first but I stuck with it. I will continue using Proactiv. Thank you
Not greasy and absorbs well. I feel my skin is evening out in texture. Wish it were packaged more cute.
I've been using this for 6 months and haven't seen any real results.

avis.titre: do NOT use if you have dry skin
avis.texte: to keep it simple, the fact this product is always one of the top three whenever i am looking for a moisturizer specifically for dry skin is absolutely wild, because so many of the ingredients are very drying. this left my face brught red and cinstsntly burning like a sunburn, skin so dry that its constantly flakking off my fsce.
I really love the moisturizer. It's not heavy, oily or irritating. I have very sensitive skin and this feels great on my skin!

I have adult stress and hormone-related acne. This product solves the problem quickly. Within days of using, acne was reduced or gone, and with continued use, this product keeps new acne at bay while also reducing the appearance of dark spots. It's also not too drying, but you really need to use a good moisturizer on top of the Perfecting Hydrator. Just give each layer of product a couple of minutes to completely absorb into your skin. Give it a try. You'll be pleased with the results.

I had to go through a lot of dryness when I first started using the proactive+ kit. But now that it's been 2 months and my skin is starting to adjust, OMG it loves this moisturizer. I have combination skin. If you're experiencing too much dryness, I recommend alternating this with the green tea moisturizer.
It doesn't dry out your skin while it fights acne. I also like that it doesn't have an odor and it does not bleach your clothes.
